item.title: Democrats Solemnly Remember The Only Riot They Didn't Like
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — On the anniversary of the January 6, 2021, incident at the U.S. Capitol, Democrat lawmakers gathered together once again to solemnly remember the only riot they didn't like.

item.title: Mamdani Tunes Into ‘The View’ To Receive His Classified Morning Briefing
item.description: NEW YORK, NY — A statement from the mayor's office confirmed Zohran Mamdani was following the situation in Venezuela very closely and would have more to report after his classified morning briefing, which he receives from watching The View.

item.title: Trump In High-Speed Chase From International Cops After Breaking International Law
item.description: SOMEWHERE IN THE NEVADA DESERT — U.S. President Donald Trump was spotted fleeing from international cops in a high-speed chase after allegedly breaking international law again.

item.title: Parenting Tip: Limit Your Child To Just 4 Hours Of Brain Rot Slop Each Day
item.description: U.S. — Experts are now recommending parents limit their children to just four hours of brain-rotting slop each day to better prepare them for the future.

item.title: Awkward: Biden Forced To Pay Trump The $25 Million Bounty For Capturing Maduro
item.description: WILMINGTON, DE — With the successful military operation to topple the authoritarian Venezuelan government, former President Joe Biden was notified that he was being forced to pay Donald Trump the $25 million bounty his administration had put in place for capturing Nicolas Maduro.

item.title: Libertarian Politician Googles 'What Is The Absolute Dumbest Take Possible' Before Deciding What Side Of Issue To Come Down On
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — In the fallout of recent events, witnesses on Capitol Hill reported seeing one Libertarian politician Googling "What is the absolute dumbest take possible?" before deciding what side of an issue to come down on.
